title: Loss function to train the embeddings

cues.en: This video is a bit of a tangent from the surrounding videos about training the embeddings model, but the loss function is so important to understand.
cues.zh: 這支影片，稍微岔開前後訓練嵌入模型的主題，但損失函式非常重要。

cues.en: It comes up every time you train a deep learning model.
cues.zh: 每次訓練深度學習模型，都會用到。

cues.en: It comes up in this course when we train GPT from scratch, it'll come up again in the mechanistic interpretability section, for example, about training autoencoders.
cues.zh: 本課程從零訓練 GPT，以及機制可解釋性章節，例如訓練自動編碼器時，也會再出現。

cues.en: So I think it's worth taking a lecture just to really nail this point home.
cues.zh: 所以，值得用一講，把這個重點弄清楚。

cues.en: I will start with a very general statement about what a loss function is.
cues.zh: 先很一般地說明，什麼是損失函式。

cues.en: A loss function is a mathematical expression of the discrepancy between the model's output and the target value.
cues.zh: 它是模型輸出與目標值差異的數學表示。

cues.en: Now, the model's output is the final result of all of its internal calculations, and the target value is the label of the data or the data category.
cues.zh: 模型輸出，是所有內部計算的最終結果；目標值，則是資料標籤或類別，

cues.en: Or sometimes it's the input data itself.
cues.zh: 有時，也是輸入資料本身，

cues.en: If we're working with an autoencoder for example.
cues.zh: 例如自動編碼器。

cues.en: So basically the output is what the model thinks the state of the world is, and the target value is what the true state of the world is.
cues.zh: 基本上，輸出是模型認為的世界狀態，目標則是真實世界狀態。

cues.en: Now obviously you want those two to match.
cues.zh: 顯然，希望兩者相符。

cues.en: And so the goal of gradient descent is to find the weights in the model that minimize the loss function.
cues.zh: 所以，梯度下降的目標，是找出能讓損失函式最小的模型權重。

cues.en: So I have some refresher videos about this at the very end of the course in the appendix section.
cues.zh: 課程最後的附錄，有幾支複習影片，

cues.en: If you want a review of gradient descent and minimizing loss functions.
cues.zh: 如果想複習梯度下降與損失最小化，可以看。

cues.en: I don't know how many loss functions there are that are regularly used in deep learning.
cues.zh: 我不知道，深度學習中常用的損失函式有多少種，

cues.en: In general, I'd say it's probably around a half dozen or so.
cues.zh: 大概六種左右。

cues.en: Different loss functions have different assumptions and are used for different kinds of data and different problems that the model is trying to solve.
cues.zh: 不同損失有不同假設，適用於不同資料，以及模型要解的不同問題。

cues.en: But all of the loss.
cues.zh: 但所有損失

cues.en: Functions are designed to be as simple as possible.
cues.zh: 函式，都盡量設計得簡單。

cues.en: Mathematically, estimating the gradients in really large models is already a really difficult computational task.
cues.zh: 數學上，大型模型的梯度估計，本來就是很困難的計算任務。

cues.en: So the simpler and the better characterized the loss function can be, the more effective and stable it's likely to be in training.
cues.zh: 損失越簡單、性質越清楚，訓練越可能有效且穩定。

cues.en: Here is just a reminder about how the weights get updated.
cues.zh: 這裡複習，權重如何更新。

cues.en: We take the loss function and its derivative scaled by some learning rate, which is a small number that just slows down and stabilizes learning.
cues.zh: 取損失函式的導數，乘以學習率；那是個小數字，用來放慢、穩定學習。

cues.en: And then we adjust the model weights according to that loss.
cues.zh: 再依損失，調整模型權重。

cues.en: So if we want to settle on a good set of weights, then we want this derivative to go to zero, which is what happens when the loss is at its minimum.
cues.zh: 想找到好的權重，就希望導數趨近 0，也就是損失達到最小時的情況。

cues.en: Here you see three different examples of loss functions that are used in deep learning.
cues.zh: 這裡有三種深度學習損失的例子。

cues.en: The first one is mean squared error, where we're just trying to get the model output, which is y hat to match the real world data, which is y.
cues.zh: 第一個是均方誤差，讓模型輸出 y hat，盡量符合真實資料 y。

cues.en: Maybe this is an image that we're trying to compress with minimum distortions or something like that.
cues.zh: 也許是想以最小失真壓縮影像等等。

cues.en: Later on in the course, you'll see that we use sparse autoencoders to do to identify circuits and latent components inside the transformer models.
cues.zh: 課程後面，會用稀疏自動編碼器，辨識 Transformer 內部的迴路與潛在成分，

cues.en: And so we will use this kind of a loss function.
cues.zh: 就會使用這種損失。

cues.en: This second one here is cross entropy which I'm going to talk about more on the next slide.
cues.zh: 第二個是交叉熵，下一張投影片再談。

cues.en: And then this one here is called k distance where you try to get two probability distributions to match each other in shape.
cues.zh: 這個則是 KL 距離，想讓兩個機率分布的形狀相符。

cues.en: We actually will use KL distance later in the course though not as a loss function but to investigate internal model calculations.
cues.zh: 課程後面會使用 KL 距離，但不是當損失，而是研究模型內部計算。

cues.en: Anyway, let's focus on this second loss function here.
cues.zh: 先專注第二個損失。

cues.en: The primary loss function that's used in language modeling is negative log likelihood.
cues.zh: 語言建模主要使用的損失，是負對數概似。

cues.en: The function in PyTorch for this is this ridiculous looking word here, which has so many L's that it makes me think that the developers were just having some fun.
cues.zh: PyTorch 函式，就是這個有點荒謬的字，L 多到讓我覺得開發者在開玩笑。

cues.en: But this stands for negative log likelihood loss.
cues.zh: 它代表 negative log likelihood loss，負對數概似損失。

cues.en: So log likelihood is used for categorization tasks.
cues.zh: 對數概似，用於分類任務。

cues.en: And that is literally the goal of language model training.
cues.zh: 這正是語言模型訓練的目標，

cues.en: We want to predict a missing token.
cues.zh: 要預測缺少的 token。

cues.en: And we consider tokens to be categorical.
cues.zh: 把 token 視為類別，

cues.en: That is to say each token is a unique category and all of the tokens are mutually exclusive.
cues.zh: 也就是每個 token 是獨特類別，而且互斥。

cues.en: So if a token is the word table, it cannot simultaneously be the word door.
cues.zh: 如果 token 是 table，就不可能同時是 door。

cues.en: So the predictions are all discrete and mutually exclusive categories, which means that we can use cross entropy loss.
cues.zh: 預測都是離散、互斥的類別，因此可以使用交叉熵損失。

cues.en: Here again is that formula that I showed in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 這是上一張投影片的公式。

cues.en: Actually, in the previous slide I wrote out the word log.
cues.zh: 上一張寫 log，

cues.en: And here I'm using ln for natural log.
cues.zh: 這裡用 ln，代表自然對數，

cues.en: But that doesn't affect the nature of the loss function anyway.
cues.zh: 但不影響損失函式的性質。

cues.en: So the idea is that the blue y is the true category label, or the probability of the category label,
cues.zh: 藍色 y，是真實類別標籤，或該類別的機率；

cues.en: and the yellow white y hat is the probability of the model picking that category.
cues.zh: 黃色的 y hat，則是模型選擇該類別的機率。

cues.en: So this equation here is what's called binary cross entropy, which means that y can only take one of two possible values.
cues.zh: 這個式子，叫二元交叉熵，代表 y 只能取兩種值。

cues.en: So for example, today it rains or it doesn't rain.
cues.zh: 例如，今天下雨，或不下雨。

cues.en: What is the probability that it rains.
cues.zh: 下雨機率是多少？

cues.en: Let's call that y.
cues.zh: 叫它 y。

cues.en: And then the probability that it doesn't rain is one minus y Why?
cues.zh: 不下雨的機率，就是 1 減 y。

cues.en: Okay, so this equation, as I've written it here, works only for one binary category.
cues.zh: 好，這種寫法，只適用於二元類別。

cues.en: But we have tens of thousands of tokens.
cues.zh: 但我們有數萬個 token，

cues.en: So we need to expand this equation quite a bit.
cues.zh: 所以，必須擴充公式，

cues.en: And that's what I show here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: So now I'm summing up over all of the categories.
cues.zh: 現在，對所有類別加總，

cues.en: For C categories.
cues.zh: 總共有 C 個類別。

cues.en: The number of categories corresponds to the number of items in our vocab.
cues.zh: 類別數，對應詞彙表項目數。

cues.en: So in GPT two that's a bit over 50,000.
cues.zh: GPT-2 是五萬多。

cues.en: And in the toy example that we're working with here in this collection of videos, that's 4500 something.
cues.zh: 這幾支影片的小型範例，則是 4500 多。

cues.en: Now you might be looking at these two equations and wondering what happened to the one minus y term.
cues.zh: 也許你比較兩個式子，想問，1 減 y 那項怎麼消失了？

cues.en: Well, here's the thing.
cues.zh: 是這樣的，

cues.en: When we're talking about discrete, mutually exclusive categories, the next token either is or isn't from this category, which means that y is either 1 or 0.
cues.zh: 談離散、互斥類別時，下一個 token，不是屬於這類，就是不屬於，所以 y 是 1 或 0。

cues.en: So if you consider that y is either 1 or 0, then all of these one minus y terms just turn into zero and they just disappear.
cues.zh: 考慮 y 只會是 1 或 0，這些 1 減 y 的項，就變成 0、消失了。

cues.en: And what is this summation here over n.
cues.zh: 這裡對 n 加總，又是什麼？

cues.en: Well if you have multiple predictions at the same time then you would sum over however many predictions you're making.
cues.zh: 如果同時有多個預測，就對預測數量加總。

cues.en: Now, I mentioned before that although the model tries to predict each token in the sequence, we only calculate the loss for the final token.
cues.zh: 之前提過，雖然模型預測序列中每個 token，但只算最後一個的損失。

cues.en: Again, the reason for that is to allow the model to accumulate more information from previous tokens.
cues.zh: 同樣，是讓模型累積先前 token 的更多資訊。

cues.en: But the upshot is that this summation term actually completely drops out because n is only one when we calculate the loss.
cues.zh: 結果就是，算損失時 n 只有 1，所以這個加總項完全消失。

cues.en: So again, there are more than one tokens that get predicted, but the loss is only calculated from one token which is the last one.
cues.zh: 雖然預測不只一個 token，但只對最後一個計算損失。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And it gets even better than this.
cues.zh: 還能更簡單。

cues.en: Consider that because the categories are mutually exclusive.
cues.zh: 類別彼此互斥，

cues.en: Then when we loop over all of the words in the vocab, the predicted token, which is y here is literally just one token.
cues.zh: 所以走訪所有詞彙表單字時，這裡的 y，實際只對應一個 token，

cues.en: It's one for one token.
cues.zh: 只有一個 token 的 y 為 1。

cues.en: So every single iteration inside this summation has y equals zero, except for the one target token
cues.zh: 這個加總中，每次迭代的 y 都是 0，只有目標 token

cues.en: where y equals one.
cues.zh: 的 y 等於 1。

cues.en: And that is a really beautiful thing because it means that this entire equation, this whole crazy looking
cues.zh: 這非常漂亮，因為整個式子，這個看似複雜、

cues.en: thing with two summations, literally just boils down to one number, which is minus the natural log of the model prediction for the target token.
cues.zh: 有兩個加總的東西，最後只剩一個數：模型對目標 token 預測機率的負自然對數。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: By the way, everything I've described so far is cross entropy.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，剛才描述的，全是交叉熵。

cues.en: Negative log likelihood is exactly the same, but we have to logsoftmax the data first.
cues.zh: 負對數概似相同，但資料要先做 log_softmax。

cues.en: Now, here's another question for you.
cues.zh: 再問你一個問題。

cues.en: Why would we want to log softmax?
cues.zh: 為什麼要 log_softmax？

cues.en: Why not just deal with the probability values themselves?
cues.zh: 為什麼不直接處理機率值？

cues.en: After all, probability values are a restricted numerical range.
cues.zh: 畢竟，機率的數值範圍有限，

cues.en: They're very well characterized mathematically, and probability values are super easy for us humans to interpret.
cues.zh: 數學性質很清楚，人類也很容易解讀。

cues.en: So you might know the answer to this question of why we prefer log probabilities instead of probabilities.
cues.zh: 如果上過我的深度學習課，或其他機器學習、深度學習課，

cues.en: If you've taken my deep learning course or another machine learning or deep learning course anyway,
cues.zh: 可能知道，為什麼偏好對數機率。

cues.en: the answer is that the log of a probability turns out to be much better for optimization tasks like training large deep learning models.
cues.zh: 總之，答案是，機率取對數，更適合大型深度學習模型訓練這類最佳化任務。

cues.en: Here you see a graph of probabilities in blue and log probabilities in orange.
cues.zh: 圖中，藍色是機率，橘色是對數機率。

cues.en: Now the blue line looks like a flat line, but it's not.
cues.zh: 藍線看起來像水平線，但不是，

cues.en: It's technically going up.
cues.zh: 技術上，仍在上升。

cues.en: It goes from zero up to 0.9 on the y axis.
cues.zh: y 值從 0 到 0.9。

cues.en: But all of these values are so compressed, it gets really difficult to make model adjustments based on very tiny, tiny differences in numbers that are very close to zero.
cues.zh: 只是數值被壓得很緊，很難依據極接近 0 的微小差異，調整模型。

cues.en: On the other hand, the log of a number plummets down to minus infinity as p goes to zero.
cues.zh: 另一方面，p 趨近 0 時，對數會急遽下降到負無窮。

cues.en: Now this has two implications.
cues.zh: 有兩個影響。

cues.en: First of all, it means that there's a much bigger numerical range for the loss function to train the model.
cues.zh: 首先，損失函式有更大的數值範圍，可用來訓練模型。

cues.en: This means that there's much more sensitivity to closely spaced probability values.
cues.zh: 也更能分辨非常接近的機率。

cues.en: And second of all, the log transform is non-linear, which means that errors can be disproportionately penalized, which helps to speed up learning.
cues.zh: 第二，對數是非線性轉換，因此能對錯誤給予不成比例的懲罰，加快學習。

cues.en: There's also an important reason why we want to use softmax instead of just the probabilities themselves, and I'll discuss the answer to that in the code.
cues.zh: 此外，為什麼用 softmax，而不是直接用機率，還有重要原因，會在程式解釋。

cues.en: But the short answer is that softmax allows the model to continue learning from correct responses if the probability of an incorrect response is still moderately high.
cues.zh: 簡短答案是，即使答對，只要錯誤答案機率仍偏高，softmax 就讓模型繼續學習。

cues.en: All right, that was a lot of theory.
cues.zh: 理論很多。

cues.en: I now want to transition into hands on code explorations.
cues.zh: 現在，轉到實作探索。

cues.en: There are a few goals of this Python demo.
cues.zh: Python 示範有幾個目標。

cues.en: First, we're going to calculate the negative log likelihood both manually and using PyTorch functions.
cues.zh: 先手動，以及用 PyTorch 函式，計算負對數概似。

cues.en: Here you see my manual calculations.
cues.zh: 這是手動計算。

cues.en: And basically we are going to simulate a very simple model output of three numbers.
cues.zh: 基本上，模擬一個很簡單、只有三個數字輸出的模型，

cues.en: So three categories.
cues.zh: 也就是三個類別。

cues.en: And then consider what the loss values would look like when different categories are the target category.
cues.zh: 再看不同類別作為目標時，損失會是多少。

cues.en: And then we're going to do something that happens extremely often when coding deep learning, which is get some error messages in PyTorch.
cues.zh: 接著，做深度學習程式中非常常見的事：在 PyTorch 出錯。

cues.en: But don't worry, this error is intentional and I included it here as a learning opportunity.
cues.zh: 別擔心，錯誤是刻意安排，作為學習機會，

cues.en: So I can tell you a little bit more about working with PyTorch.
cues.zh: 讓我能多介紹 PyTorch。

cues.en: Finally, we are going to train a very simple model which has exactly two weights.
cues.zh: 最後，訓練一個只有兩個權重的簡單模型。

cues.en: So it's not a very deep model and one correct category.
cues.zh: 它不深，而且只有一個正確類別。

cues.en: And in this case, the model will use negative log likelihood to learn that the green square category
cues.zh: 這個例子，使用負對數概似，學會綠色方塊類別

cues.en: is correct and the blue circle category is incorrect.
cues.zh: 正確、藍色圓形類別錯誤。

cues.zh: 這支影片的程式檔，和前兩支，以及接下來幾支不同。

cues.en: So this one is called loss function.
cues.zh: 這個叫 loss function。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Here import some things from PyTorch and so on.
cues.zh: 匯入一些 PyTorch 等工具。

cues.en: this is just to.
cues.zh: 這裡只是，

cues.en: Yeah, just code to make the figure that I showed in the slides basically showing that as the probabilities
cues.zh: 對，產生投影片圖形的程式，顯示機率

cues.en: get close to zero, the log of the probabilities span a much larger numerical range.
cues.zh: 接近 0 時，對數機率涵蓋大得多的數值範圍。

cues.en: Okay, so here is one of the main goals for this coding exercise.
cues.zh: 這是這個程式練習的主要目標之一。

cues.en: Imagine we have a model that takes some input data and gives three outputs.
cues.zh: 假設模型接受輸入，提供三個輸出，

cues.en: And those outputs correspond to let's say three different categories of of options.
cues.zh: 對應三種不同類別選項。

cues.en: Maybe it's a very simple language that only has three tokens whatever.
cues.zh: 也許是只有三個 token 的極簡語言，隨便。

cues.en: So there are three outputs of this model and these are the output values.
cues.zh: 模型有三個輸出，這些是輸出值。

cues.en: So what we are going to do here actually let me first comment out this and show this okay.
cues.zh: 先註解這裡，展示這個。

cues.en: So here are the raw model outputs.
cues.zh: 這是模型原始輸出，

cues.en: Literally just the numbers I wrote up here.
cues.zh: 就是上面寫的數字。

cues.en: And here I am taking the log softmax of the model outputs.
cues.zh: 這裡取模型輸出的 log_softmax，

cues.en: So I'm applying the softmax function to these numbers to transform them into softmax probabilities.
cues.zh: 先用 softmax，把數值轉成 softmax 機率，

cues.en: And then taking their log okay.
cues.zh: 再取對數。

cues.en: And that is done here with this function Logsoftmax.
